threat_event: Attacker uses the shared remote desktop password to open spillway gates or trip units remotely
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist targeting internet-reachable control systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unattended remote desktop access with one shared password and no MFA, known to 7 people (unchanged from 2023-02 to 2026-08-12); full gate and unit control remotely; plant unattended overnight
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 3.3.3; Table 9.3a access control, voluntary); C-DAMS-R02 (18 CFR 12.10; 12.3(b)(4)(ii), (xi))
existing_controls: Remote desktop tool blocks repeated failed sign-ins; tailrace horn sounds before a gate opens; local panels can override
treatment_plan: One remote access path with named accounts, MFA, and view-only by default; gate and unit commands remotely only with Plant Superintendent approval; phone alert at every session start; weekly session review. Interim: password changed 2026-08-12 and limited to 5 staff

threat_event: Former or current staff member misuses the shared OT passwords to operate the plant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No termination checklist; shared HMI and remote passwords not changed when an operator-mechanic left on 2024-11-15; his monitoring portal account stayed active until 2026-07-21
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a access control, voluntary); C-DAMS-R02 (18 CFR 12.10)
existing_controls: Small, stable staff; password changed 2026-08-12; portal account removed 2026-07-21
treatment_plan: Termination checklist covering suite, portal, remote access, HMI, keys, and gate codes on the last day; named accounts (R-001)

threat_event: Attacker who compromises the controls integrator uses its always-on cellular VPN to reach the PLCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator router connects its office directly to the control network, bypassing the firewall; no approval, MFA, or logging at the company; PLCs accept commands from anything on the network
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a: remote and third-party connections, voluntary)
existing_controls: Integrator is a small regional firm known to staff; work orders list work done
treatment_plan: Router off except for sessions a staff member starts and watches (from 2026-09-15); then retire the router and give the integrator a named, MFA-protected account on the single remote access path; security and incident notice terms in the integrator agreement

threat_event: Ransomware on an office PC spreads to the HMI PC and stops supervisory control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firewall rule lets any office device reach the HMI PC by remote desktop and file sharing; engineering laptop joins both networks; HMI PC unsupported and unpatched
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a access control and functional segregation, voluntary)
existing_controls: MSP antivirus and patching on office PCs; MFA on the suite; gate PLC keeps automatic level control without the HMI
treatment_plan: Rebuild firewall rules so no office device reaches the control network; dedicated OT-only engineering laptop; block web browsing on the HMI PC

threat_event: HMI PC or a PLC fails or is wiped and cannot be rebuilt within the RTO
threat_source: Hardware failure, ransomware, or bad change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Company holds no copy of PLC logic, the HMI project, or governor and exciter settings; integrator copies from 2023-05-18 never restore-tested; no spare HMI PC; no OT recovery procedure
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a system restoration and recovery, voluntary)
existing_controls: Local panels for gates and units; integrator can rebuild in time
treatment_plan: Collect current copies onto 2 encrypted drives (one in the office safe) after every change and quarterly; written OT recovery procedure; restore test on the replacement HMI PC

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported HMI operating system through web browsing or a malicious file
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system out of vendor support since October 2025; antivirus signatures from 2024; staff browse weather websites on it
existing_controls: Firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic from the internet
treatment_plan: Replace the HMI PC with a supported operating system and current HMI software; until then no browsing and no office access to it

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting gates or units is not recognized or reported to FERC as an 18 CFR 12.10 condition
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff do not know that cyber security incidents are reportable conditions (12.3(b)(4)(xi)); EAP and ODSP do not mention cyber events; no incident response plan before 2026-08-31
existing_controls: 12.10 reporting used for physical conditions (2024, 2025)
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook; reporting rule in annual training; add cyber events to the ODSP communication section; tabletop with county emergency management

threat_event: FERC issues a directive or the next inspection finds the remote control capability still has no security plan
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group 3 duties are recommendations, but the FERC engineer recommended a cyber security plan at the 2025-11-04 inspection; the Regional Engineer may require action under 18 CFR 12.4(b)
existing_controls: SSP (P02) approved 2026-08-31
treatment_plan: Short site security plan (physical) with the SSP as its cyber section; brief Security Assessment built from this register; show both at the next inspection

threat_event: Drawings, inundation maps, or the control network drawing leak through open sharing links
threat_source: Outside party who receives a forwarded link
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CEII folder open to all staff and shared by "anyone with the link" with the integrator and consulting engineer
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 3.2 OPSEC; Form 1 Q22); 18 CFR 388.113 (internal handling)
existing_controls: Suite MFA for staff
treatment_plan: Restricted CEII folder with named external guests; remove "anyone with the link" shares; label documents

threat_event: Default passwords on the camera NVR or the cellular data gateway are used to blind cameras or alter readings sent to the monitoring service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manufacturer default passwords found in P07 testing (2026-08-11); both devices reachable over cellular or the vendor relay
existing_controls: Devices are not exposed to inbound internet connections
treatment_plan: Change both passwords; add default-password check to the change form; separate phone app logins

threat_event: Phishing or business email compromise redirects a payment or steals suite credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Little training; payment changes accepted by email
existing_controls: MFA on the suite; MSP email filtering
treatment_plan: Annual training; call-back rule for any change to bank details

threat_event: Monitoring service outage at night means a high-water or unit trip alarm is not answered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single alarm path through the monitoring SaaS; vendor RTO 12 hours versus BIA 8 hours
existing_controls: Gate PLC keeps automatic level control; vendor SOC 2 availability commitments
treatment_plan: Vendor outage notice by text to the Plant Superintendent; staff the control room overnight when the service is down; check outage terms at renewal

threat_event: Hurricane cuts power, roads, and communications for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single site; small staff; weak cellular coverage at the dam
regulatory_driver: 18 CFR 12.22 (EAP); C-DAMS-R02 (12.10 for conditions affecting safety)
existing_controls: EAP; standby generator for gates; property and business interruption insurance
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the OT recovery procedure: pre-storm fuel, staff rota, satellite messenger for the on-call phone, printed contacts

threat_event: Cellular carrier outage stops alarm callouts and remote viewing overnight
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One carrier for the gateway, the integrator router, and staff phones at the dam
existing_controls: Gate PLC keeps level automatically; monitoring service raises a "gateway offline" alert after 15 minutes
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Owner: outages have been short; the "gateway offline" alert prompts a drive-in; revisit if an outage passes 4 hours

threat_event: Standby generator fails when gates must be moved during a flood with grid power lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One portable generator; fuel kept on site for about 24 hours
existing_controls: Annual load test with verified statement
treatment_plan: Monthly no-load run; fuel supply agreement; rental generator contact in the EAP

threat_event: Malware reaches the HMI PC on a USB drive or the engineering laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ordinary USB drives used to move files; engineering laptop joins office Wi-Fi and the control network
existing_controls: MSP antivirus on office PCs
treatment_plan: One company OT USB drive, scanned before use; OT-only engineering laptop (R-004)

threat_event: Staff rely on the AI anomaly add-on and miss a developing dam safety condition
threat_source: AI model error and automation bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trial switched on without review; back-test missed 2 of 9 events; manual weir not covered
existing_controls: Daily walk-downs and weekly manual readings continue
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: advisory only; manual readings and trigger-point checks unchanged; monthly alert review

threat_event: Monitoring vendor uses dam safety data to train models for other customers or exposes it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trial terms allow use of customer data to improve models; no contract security terms
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 (Security and Availability)
treatment_plan: Contract clause: no use of company data for other customers' models; incident notice; AI add-on in the next SOC 2 scope

threat_event: Staff paste CEII or employee information into public AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule on AI tools before 2026-08-31
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-04 AI rule; briefing in annual training

threat_event: Employee personal information is exposed through the suite or the payroll service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR files in the suite; payroll SaaS
existing_controls: MFA on suite and payroll; HR folder limited to 2 users
treatment_plan: Keep the HR folder limited; P08 matrix covers Florida notice

threat_event: Lost or stolen office laptop exposes company files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel with staff
existing_controls: MSP full-disk encryption on all 3 office laptops; MSP can wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Owner: encrypted devices; residual risk Low. The engineering laptop is handled under R-016

threat_event: Trespasser from the recreation area tampers with the hoist house or gate panels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recreation area next to the dam; hoist house key not returned by a former employee
existing_controls: Locked hoist house; panel key switches; camera on the spillway; sheriff patrols
treatment_plan: Change the hoist house lock; key inventory every year

threat_event: A vendor update turns on the monitoring service's setpoint-write feature, creating a command path from the cloud to the gates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature exists in the product; disabled for this site only by vendor setting; no contract term
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a access control and functional segregation, voluntary)
existing_controls: Vendor confirmed the feature is disabled (2026-07-21)
treatment_plan: Contract term: feature stays off unless the Owner requests it in writing; gateway set to read-only at the PLC side
